weekLabel: Week of Aug 9 to Aug 16 · refreshed Sunday Aug 9. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.when: Sat Aug 15 & Sun Aug 16, 9am-6pm Sat / 9am-5pm Sun
events.name: Gloucester Waterfront Festival
events.meta: Free entry (parking fee) · Stage Fort Park, Gloucester · 45th year: 150+ booths of arts, crafts, and food with live music right on the harbor. Classic whole-family Cape Ann day. Go early and reserve beach parking online, it fills up. source

events.name: Patriots preseason vs Colts
events.meta: Ticketed · Gillette Stadium · First home game of the year, a low-stakes way to get in the building before the season. Big one for Dave and Alex. source

events.name: Landmarks Orchestra: Organ Symphony
events.meta: Free · DCR Hatch Shell, Esplanade · The 25th anniversary season finale: Saint-Saens' Organ Symphony plus Respighi's Fountains of Rome. Blankets and a picnic, no alcohol. source

events.name: Chinatown August Moon Festival
events.meta: Free · Phillips Square, Boston Chinatown · Lion dances, Chinese opera, folk dance, plus food and vendor tables through the streets. A fun, packed city afternoon if you want to get out today. source

events.name: African Festival of Boston
events.meta: Cost (verify) · Boston Common · 16th year, a full day of music, food, and culture on the Common. Easy to pair with a city walk. source

events.name: SoWa Open Market
events.meta: Free entry · 500 Harrison Ave, Boston · 100+ makers, food trucks, farmers market, vintage. The standing Stacey city day. source

events.name: Lake Street Dive at Thompson's Point
events.meta: Ticketed, ~$63 advance ($116 two-day pass) · Thompson's Point, Portland ME · Waterfront outdoor show, Boston band Couch opens both nights. One for KK, worth the drive for a standout show. Buy ahead. source

events.name: Patriots preseason vs Eagles
events.meta: Ticketed · Gillette Stadium · Second and final home preseason game. source

events.name: Salisbury Riverfest
events.meta: Free · Salisbury Beach boardwalk · A full day of live concerts on the boardwalk, then beachfront fireworks at 10:15pm (verify lineup). source

events.name: Revolution vs NYCFC
events.meta: Ticketed, from ~$40 · Gillette Stadium · The next MLS home game. Book early to pair it with the Aug 22 Patriots game for a Foxborough weekend. source
